verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented programmatic way to create or update Ente Auth entries. Entries are added by scanning a QR code or typing details by hand. The official CLI is described only as export and backup tooling, the only deep link is for search, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Generating a plaintext import file is a user-side workaround: the import itself is done manually inside the app, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create and update vault entries — seeding new TOTP secrets, storing credentials — through documented programmatic surfaces
